source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The new mock setup test adds twelve account/server assertions without a diagnostic message, including the OAuth2 authentication-method checks requested in review. Nearby comments and field values do not provide the assertion message. The fixed accepted test adds three identity checks in a later phase and those also lack messages. Scope a diagnostic to each expected field; do not infer that the missing messages make the checked values incorrect. No browser test was run.
title: Thundermail setup field assertions need their own expected-result messages
